triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

jp: イツキと怪樹ふるそま
triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

name: Blaze Green, Burn Bright!
triggerText: Discard this Waza, then draw 3 cards.
flavor: Some battles simply cannot be lost. Even in those moments, Horobeats use their Waza to strengthen themselves and fight on without fear.

name: Snoozing Jumbo
effect: ●When this Horobeat is Overbeaten, if this Horobeat is downed, draw 1 card.
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: The "Horobeats" fight on in hiding within modern society. They are yokai who, as civilization advanced, lost both the power and the place to live — and had been on the verge of fading away entirely.

name: Kesaran-Pasaran
effect: ●1 Barrier (When you lose a battle, the damage you take is reduced by 1.)
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor:
Mysterious, mysterious Kesaran-Pasaran, come from a sky so far away.

Nestled with face powder in a little box, a fluffy white ball that carries happiness.

Mysterious Horobeat, Kesaran-Pasaran, and off to that far sky it flew away.

— Furarinte

name: Temple Cat Leomaru

triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: When a Horobeat wins a battle, you deal damage to your opponent's Hearts. Destroy all of your opponent's Hearts and land the finishing blow — that's how you win, meow~.

name: Danda Dunk and Bakezouri
jp: 弾田ダンクとバケゾウリ
effect: ●When this Horobeat is destroyed, draw 1 card.
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)

Entry Triggers put cards straight into your line, Over Triggers transform them on the spot, and Last Over Triggers — the most powerful of all — activate when your opponent has 1 or fewer Hearts left! There are also Draw Triggers to grow your hand. Turn crisis into opportunity and go for the comeback win~!

name: Fateful Meeting: Leo and Jin
jp: 運命の出会い レオとジン

●When you use Boost on this Horobeat, draw 1 card.

(Does not trigger from Waza.)
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: At the end of your turn, you may draw 1 card for each Ena you didn't use. That's Ena Draw! Leaving Ena unspent to prepare for what's next is a valid strategy.

jp: お出迎え 七尾とヒナタ

flavor: In battle, two Horobeats facing each other compete with their power. When you can't win, pay 1 Ena to use a Boost from your hand and power up. Take a look at the left side of the card — that's the Boost.

name: Kamaitachi Kamachi the Weasel
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: Transform into a big, powerful Horobeat at a bargain price! That's Overbeat! If a Horobeat costs 6, you can Overbeat into me for just 3 cost!

●When this Horobeat wins a battle, draw 1 card.

(Triggers even if there is no opposing Horobeat.)
triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: Win a battle and deal damage to both the opposing Horobeat and their Hearts. And with me, you even get a bonus — draw extra cards! More cards means a faster path to victory. The more you win, the better it gets for Betobeto!

jp: 連打！ カミナリ小僧
effect: ●Double Damage (If this Horobeat wins a battle, deal 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)
triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

effect:

●When this Horobeat enters play, draw 2 cards.
triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

name: Fusion Leojin
effect:
●Double Damage (If this Horobeat wins a battle, deal 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

●If you have 4 or more Horobeats in play, this Horobeat gets +3000 Power.

effect: ●When you use this Waza, recover this Horobeat.
triggerText: Discard this Waza, then draw 3 cards.
flavor: Even if you lose a battle and take damage, using "recover" lets you get back up again. If an ally is down, use this Waza to prepare for the next fight.

name: Lightning Strike
triggerText: Discard this Waza, then draw 3 cards.
flavor: During battle, you can spend Ena to use Waza and Boost. That's how you fight in Horobeat! Even when you're losing on power, unleashing this Waza mid-battle can flip things around. Close in on victory!

name: Thunder and Wind Raging Surge
effect: ●If this Horobeat wins this battle, it deals +1 damage to the opposing player.
triggerText: Discard this Waza, then draw 3 cards.
flavor: Now for the final stretch. Using Waza and Boost to their fullest is the key to victory. Win the battle and smash the opponent's Heart in one go — a comeback win is well within reach!

effect: ●When this Horobeat is Overbeaten, if this Horobeat is downed, draw 1 card.
triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)

name: Solo Camp Shinazui-sama
jp: ソロキャンしなずいさま

●If Boost has been used on this Horobeat, it gets +2000 Power.

(Does not trigger from Waza.)

triggerText: Play this Horobeat to a line. (Without paying its cost.)

effect: ●1 Barrier (When you lose a battle, the damage you take is reduced by 1.)

triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)
flavor: When you Overbeat a Horobeat into play, place it on top of a Horobeat already in play. When playing one without Overbeating, line them up side by side in the second line, third line, and so on to send them into battle.

triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

triggerText: Play this Horobeat via Overbeat. (Without paying its cost.)

Entry Triggers let you put a card straight into play, Over Triggers let you Overbeat for free, Last Over Triggers are powerful effects you can use when you have 1 or fewer Hearts remaining, and Draw Triggers let you draw a card. Keep all of that in mind!
